POST /api/containers/{containerId}/files added the new required request property `files`
PUT /api/containers/{containerId}/settings removed the request property `summary`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeAzureBlobContainerScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeConfluenceSpaceScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeCustomSourceScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeGitHubRepositoryScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeJiraProjectScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeS3BucketScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
POST /api/sources removed the enum value `filesystem` of the request property `scope/oneOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScopeSftpFolderScope]/allOf[#/components/schemas/SourceScope]/type`
# CON-335: table columns gain the Json type for nested values kept whole as jsonb. The tables API hasn't shipped yet,
# so no client relies on the old set of column types.
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/tables added the new `Json` enum value to the `items/items/columns/items/type` response property for the response status `200`
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/tables/{tableId} added the new `Json` enum value to the `columns/items/type` response property for the response status `200`
PUT /api/containers/{containerId}/tables/{tableId}/hidden added the new `Json` enum value to the `columns/items/type` response property for the response status `200`
PUT /api/containers/{containerId}/tables/{tableId}/hidden-columns added the new `Json` enum value to the `columns/items/type` response property for the response status `200`
